data.name: Night Ambient (demo)
data.note: Demo scene for Parts mode (Roadmap 4.0 · C3). Load it with ⇧ Scene in the Arrangement module (it turns Parts on by itself) and press ▶ Play in Harmony. D minor, i-VI-III-VII at 72 bpm; four players that come in with the energy of the 32-bar cycle: the pad always, the sub from 0.3, the bell at 0.55 and the hat at 0.75. Parts refer to factory presets by name + settings (an exported scene carries the full state). [Archived with 1.4: the parts carry their presets inlined.]

data.name: Dorian Dawn
data.note: F Dorian, i-IV-VII-IV at 84 bpm: the classic Dorian vamp, bright without being major. A wavetable vowel choir holds the chords with its morph drifting (the vowels change on their own), a creamy bass comes in with the first light, the FM glockenspiel draws a sparse melody across two octaves and a music box marks a triplet when the energy rises. 24-bar cycle; high Open so the filter dawns with the energy. [Archived with 1.4: the parts carry their presets inlined.]

data.name: Hypnotic Techno
data.note: A minor pentatonic at 126 bpm, almost static (i-i-iv-i, one bar per chord). An 808 kick on quarter notes that drops out in the energy valleys (breakdown), an Acid 303 in mono whose SEQUENCER phrase is transposed by each chord's root (Root + Seq = Phrase) and whose cutoff drifts on its own, a Wavestation texture ARPEGGIATED in sixteenths over two octaves (Chord + Arp) that only comes in at the peak, and an FM hat in E(7,16) with accents. 16-bar cycle, high Surprise: one-bar gaps. NOTE: Seq and Arp run in real time — in the selftest's offline render those two parts are silent. [Archived with 1.4: the parts carry their presets inlined.]

data.name: Robot Choir
data.note: D hirajoshi (Japanese pentatonic) at 66 bpm with the harmony in FUNCTIONS mode: the T→S/D→T walk picks the degrees. Everything is the Vocal module: a madrigal of voices (a different vowel per note) holds the chords with the base vowel drifting, a glottal voice drones the root and fifth, a talking robot sings the melody softly, and the vocal percussion «ka» plays an E(5,12) when there is energy. Big dark hall, tape echo with wow: a robot cave. [Archived with 1.4: the parts carry their presets inlined.]
